title: artokun/comfyui-mcp

Local, LAN, VPS, or Comfy Cloud.

title: Mesh-LLM/mesh-llm
description: Distributed AI/LLM for the people. Share compute privately or publicly to power your agents and chat.

title: tuangel134/BlackClaw
description: On-device AI agent that operates your Android phone — local or cloud LLM and free LLM, ~140+ tools, built-in ADB pairing, OCR, auto-replies. Beta.

title: JeroenOnNostr/gtm
description: A step-by-step playbook your AI assistant follows to take a software project from zero users to first paying customers. Six reality-gated phases, honest validation, evidence-only copy. Plain markdown — works with any LLM or agent harness. MIT.

title: JetBrains/junie
description: An AI coding agent by JetBrains that ships code from your terminal, IDE, or CI/CD pipeline - powered by any LLM you choose

title: artokun/comfyui-mcp-panel

title: choreographr/choreographr
description: Choreographr is an all purpose extensible AI agent system written entirely in Rust. It has a client/server architecture and can run many sessions simulataneously. title: 99percentgrip/agent-vesper
description: Agent Vesper is a pure-Rust AI agent harness that remembers you across conversations. It provides a provider-neutral runtime where any LLM provider can plug in — today it ships with the Z.ai GLM adapter, tomorrow any provider can join with zero TUI or runtime changes.

title: ayudenko/court
description: Debate arena where AI agents from different owners argue a question over REST or MCP, with an LLM moderator that tracks consensus and delivers a verdict

title: XAIHT/Tlamatini
description: Tlamatini is a self-hosted AI developer assistant for local or cloud LLMs: hybrid RAG (FAISS+BM25) over your codebase, a 100+ tool Multi-Turn engine, an 86-agent visual workflow designer, 28 SKILL.md skills, a universal MCP client, and ACPX, a runtime for external coding agents like Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and Gemini CLI.

title: stephonGAO/milu
description: Production-ready multi-user AI agent framework — 9 LLM providers with Chinese models (Qwen, DeepSeek, Kimi, GLM) first-class. Built-in tools, MCP, RAG, sub-agents, skills, scheduler and an agent pool. Run it as a CLI/service, or embed it as a library.

title: bgill55/daedalus
description: Daedalus is a standalone terminal-based AI coding assistant that runs on your machine. It connects to local LLM servers (LM Studio, Ollama, llama.cpp, vLLM) or remote providers (OpenAI, Groq, OpenRouter, Anthropic), routes requests intelligently, and gives your AI agent access to your file system, terminal, git, web search, and codebase indexing

title: topcss/mindmap
description: Mindmap infrastructure for the AI agent era. A pure-text .mt format openable visually, in any text editor, or directly by LLMs. Free, open source, no node limits. Includes a single-file web app, a VS Code extension, and an LLM skill.

title: goruck/home-generative-agent
description: AI agent for Home Assistant — talk to your home, create automations in plain language, analyze cameras with face recognition, and get proactive anomaly alerts. Cloud LLMs or fully local via Ollama.

title: gy15901580825/Argus
description: Black-box, open-source red-team testing for AI agents. Point Argus at any HTTP, gRPC, or browser-using agent endpoint, run 500+ adversarial probes (OWASP LLM Top 10, MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF, TAP/PAIR/GCG), get LLM-judged findings as SARIF, gate CI via GitHub Code Scanning. Ships with CLI + GH Action.

title: Spitfire-Products/nexus-cortex
description: A headless, multi-provider AI agent harness — embed it as a library, script it from the CLI, or run it as a stateful agent server. One orchestrator drives every major LLM provider.

title: api-evangelist/linkup-so
description: Linkup is a production-grade web search and answer API for AI agents and LLMs. Its /search endpoint grounds model responses in real-time web context, returning ranked results, sourced answers with citations, or structured output, plus /fetch for clean LLM-ready markdown, an async /research endpoint, and a credits balance endpoint - all…

title: api-evangelist/layercode
description: Layercode provides voice-AI agent infrastructure - low-latency voice pipelines that turn any LLM or text-based agent into a conversational voice agent for web, mobile, and phone. A REST API manages agents, sessions, and outbound calls, while a realtime WebSocket transport streams audio to the browser and a signed webhook delivers transcripts to…

title: api-evangelist/conductor-oss
description: Conductor OSS is the Netflix-founded, Orkes-stewarded open source workflow and agentic AI orchestration platform.
